findings.message: The rule that an untracked release must get its name, category, start and target together now exists twice, and the two copies disagree. updateRelease (services.ts:493) also requires `input.name`. proposeReleaseEdit only looks at category and the two dates. The Name field is filled in from the stored name, but it isn't part of the input unless the person edits it (withEdits only copies edited fields). So the card accepts every edit and the write then fails. Fix: use one shared predicate in both places, and either require `name` on the card or let the service fall back to the stored name.
findings.scenario: An untracked release (CON v2.4.0) → 'Ask amax to track it' → pick UAT and type the start and target, leaving Name as shown. Each edit check passes. Save fails with 'CON v2.4.0 isn't tracked yet: give its name, category, start and target together'.

findings.message: releaseEditCard fills every field from the stored row (`value("target_date")` and the rest) and ignores the values the tool call carries (`a.name`, `a.category`, `a.startDate`, `a.targetDate`). Confirm writes args plus edits (packages/chat/src/edits.ts withEdits), so it saves values the card never showed. The title also uses the stored name while `done` uses `a.name`. Fix: fill each field with `a.<field> ?? stored`.
findings.scenario: 'Move CON e1's target to 2099-01-15'. The model calls update_release with targetDate 2099-01-15. The card's Target field shows 2099-12-31. The person clicks Save without editing and 2099-01-15 is written, a date they never saw on the confirm card.

findings.message: completedDay prints the completion day in UTC. completionOf, which decides 'On time' or 'Late', uses the day in the project's entity zone (release-tracking.ts completeBy → releaseDay(zoneOf…)). The page can show a completion date on or before the target next to 'Late', or the reverse. Fix: format completedAt with the same releaseDay(zone, …) rule. That means carrying the zone or the zoned completion day on the read.
findings.scenario: Project zone Pacific/Kiritimati (UTC+14), target 2026-12-10. The UAT deploy at 2026-12-10T12:00Z falls on Dec 11 locally, so completion = late. The info card shows 'Completed 10 Dec 2026 · Late'.

findings.message: `toLocaleString(undefined, …)` runs first on the server, in the server's locale and time zone (UTC on Vercel and k3s). `suppressHydrationWarning` tells React to keep the server's text instead of fixing it on the client. So every deployment and status-history time shows server-zone wall time with no zone shown. Fix: format with an explicit zone (the project's, or UTC labelled as UTC), or render the time only after mount.
findings.scenario: A PM in Colombo (UTC+5:30) sees a deployment recorded at 16:30 local listed as '11:00' on the release page.

findings.message: When the release doesn't exist, releaseEditCard returns a card with no form instead of refusing. It relies on propose to block it. Saving an unchanged edit card also sends only {projectKey, version}, and the service rejects that with 'say what to change', a message that doesn't fit a card the person never changed. Refuse missing releases here too, and say 'nothing changed' for an empty save.

The `.card.flush tbody tr` region was dropped from the releases visual check, and nothing replaced it. The new rows (name, category, status, dates, progress) now have no visual-diff coverage. Add the 125 mock section's row region instead of removing the check.

Each status-history row's pin is `facet(historyPin, ' status change N: …')`, which resolves through get_release_history to the release's whole history, not to that row. The row is a record (a `release_status_history` row) and is keyed by its list position rather than an id. R3 requires a row's PinRef to resolve to that exact record by its UUID. Fix: return the history row id in `statusHistory` and add a read tool with `pin: { id, of }` that returns one status change (as get_proposal_event does for proposal history rows).
findings.scenario: A user pins the "In progress → Off track" row and asks chat about it. The pin resolves to get_release_history with every change, so chat cannot tell which row was meant.

findings.message: The 123 paragraph still says voiding the completing record "moves completion to the earliest other valid one, or reopens it". 126 removed `reopenOnVoid`, and completed is now final. Update the 123 line, or mark it as amended by 126, so the docs don't contradict the code.
